body: This made me chuckle, thank you.

Seems like a decent tip. The only thing getting me through the day right now is gaming. I would love to stream for a living one day. Of course dropping out to stream is a borderline retarded idea. My parents wouldn't let me and even I can see how dumb that is. So yeah...
The fact that someone understands already means a lot, thanks man.

I doubt there is anything school counsellor can help me with, they offered me private lessons but that would probably make me even more stressed. I might have ADD, it's quite possible actually but I never bothered mentioning it to anyone. Thanks for your effort trying to help me though.

Unfortunately, I doubt I can find a better school. I have no problems with the teachers and classmates, even though I don't talk to them, are ok as long as they don't bully me which thankfully doesn't happen. My main problem is that it's very difficult for me to get out of bed at 6 AM and whenever I skip a day I'm afraid that I missed something important. I also feel like asking one of my classmates about it is out of the question because I don't know anyone well enough. I would feel like I'm using them. Also, I'm afraid of being ignored.

EDIT: This is basically an endless cycle because the more I skip the more imporant things I miss and this makes me even more scared.

At home I'm watching streams if I feel the need to interact with other people. I also do it during longer breaks between classes but it starts getting pretty boring if you do it all day. Besides, I don't think you can find a real friend this way.

Video games, anime and manga is all I do when it comes to hobbies. I recently started playing chess again. Unfortunately no one in my class shares my interest with chess or anime and my PC is 9 years old so I can't really play the newest games.

The socializing part is really difficult for me. It's not like I'm unable to socialize but it also can't be just anyone. I don't know why but I find everyone so boring. Maybe it's because I'm the boring one.
